Drones Strike Ships Off Bulgaria, One Sinks; NATO Aid Sought

Two ships off the coast of Bulgaria in the Black Sea were struck by drones of unknown origin. One vessel sank, while the other sustained damage. Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev stated that one person was rescued and that he is seeking aid from NATO. Rescue operations are underway.
